A diversionary '''battle''' was fought between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Thrawn's fleet (Galactic Empire)|forces]] of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] during his [[Thrawn campaign|military campaign]]. The assault on Crondre was used as a feint to draw New Republic forces away from Ord Pardron, which in turn left the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] vulnerable.
